annotations.title: Send a video brief to VIDEO DEPT.

description: Sends one video brief to Nikita at VIDEO DEPT. for an exact fixed quote, with the user's name and email so he can reply. It is built from the user's own answers to the plan_a_video questions and needs at least 4 of the 10 answered. Each call sends a new brief and cannot be taken back, so call it once, after the user has seen the exact brief and their contact details and agreed.

deadline.description: What's the hard deadline, and why?

email.description: The user's email address, where Nikita sends the quote.

message.description: What's the one message they must remember?

outcome.description: What single business outcome should this video drive?

phone.description: Optional: the user's phone number, if they want Nikita to call or text them about this brief.

project_name.description: A short name for the video, e.g. "Spring launch film".

script_draft.description: Optional: the script draft you wrote with the user from draft_a_script, exactly as the user approved it. Nikita uses it as a starting point.
